_about: Public-domain John McLeod Campbell (1800-1872, minister of Row, Dunbartonshire, deposed by the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland in 1831 for teaching universal atonement and assurance) for the Word Hoard: The Nature of the Atonement, clean from CCEL. His view of the atonement departs from the Westminster divines on this list; he is here for his influence, and the shelf is Adam's to veto. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
